subject: Marketplace listing: AMI upload window & hero claims
messages:
From: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@acme.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: acme-marketplace-team@acme.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing: AMI upload window & hero claims

Hi Kimberly + Ben,

Thanks again — we're ready on our side to submit the AWS Marketplace offer and get the AMI uploaded, but a couple of outstanding items before we push: 

1) Hero claim verification: we'd like to call out a performance/cost win on the product page (e.g., “reduces inference cost by up to 50% for embedding-heavy workloads”). Do you have a preferred phrasing from legal/partner that you recommend? If your team needs benchmark artifacts or a short methods write-up we can provide the test harness and sample traces.

2) AMI upload window: our infra team prefers a nighttime window to avoid traffic — is Wed, Jul 21 between 22:00-23:30 UTC workable for Redwood to perform the AMI import + light smoke tests? If not, propose alternatives.

3) Co-sell assets: can you attach the one-pager and a small checklist of what your marketplace team needs (logos, long/short descriptions, any logos with clear brand usage guidance)? Our procurement team will need those for the seller registration.

Attaching: acme-seller-checklist.xlsx (stub)

If we can lock these down this week we should be ready to hit the private offer and co-sell enablement by next week.

Best,
Lisa Grant
Head of Cloud Partnerships
Acme Corp

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: AMI upload window & hero claims

Hi Lisa — thanks, this is great. Quick answers inline and next steps: 

On Jul 14, 2026 09:12, Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@acme.com> wrote:
> 1) Hero claim verification: we'd like to call out a performance/cost win on the product page (e.g., “reduces inference cost by up to 50% for embedding-heavy workloads”). Do you have a preferred phrasing from legal/partner that you recommend?

We usually avoid absolute statements like “50%” without a clear workload qualifier. Legal prefers phrasing such as: “reduces inference cost for common embedding workloads” paired with a parenthetical or footnote: “based on internal benchmarks using [sample workload].” I took the liberty of drafting two hero options (attached) — one conservative and one more aggressive but footnoted.

> 2) AMI upload window: Wed, Jul 21 between 22:00-23:30 UTC workable?

Yes, our infra team can make the Wed Jul 21 UTC window work, but can we shift the start to 22:30 UTC and allow a 60–90 minute window (22:30–00:00 UTC) to account for the import + smoke? Please confirm and we'll reserve the runner.

> 3) Co-sell assets: can you attach the one-pager and a small checklist of what your marketplace team needs?

Attaching our Redwood one-pager and a short asset checklist (stubs below). We also need a primary logo (PNG + SVG) and any SOC2 or security attestations you can share for the seller registration.

Attachments: redwood-product-onepager.pdf (stub), aws-sku-info.csv (stub)

Next steps: if you confirm the 22:30–00:00 UTC window I'll submit the AMI reservation and loop in the infra on-call. If legal wants benchmark artifacts, send a short README with the harness and we'll route it to our applied ML team.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Marketplace Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: AMI upload window & hero claims

Kimberly — thanks for the quick turnaround. Kim's conservative phrasing is the right path for the public listing. A couple concrete hero lines we can use (short, A/B test friendly):

- "Lower inference costs for embedding and search workloads"
- "Production-grade LLM inference with predictable latency and lower unit cost"
- "Optimized GPU inference for high-throughput applications"

Legal suggested adding a single parenthetical: "(based on internal benchmarks; results vary by workload)." If Acme wants a callout about cost improvements we can add an expandable FAQ entry showing the test methodology — otherwise steer clear of a point figure on the hero.

Marissa — can you pull the co-sell enablement checklist and a short speaker deck we can share with Acme's field? I'd like a one-slide co-sell play (what success looks like, intro script, demo asks).

Attaching: hero-copy-options.docx (stub)

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference

On Tue, Jul 14, 2026 at 11:05 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai> wrote:

Thanks — that all sounds good. We confirm the AMI upload window of Wed Jul 21 22:30–00:00 UTC. Our infra lead will be on the call for the import.

On the hero copy, we'll take the conservative line with the parenthetical reference and request an expandable FAQ with the methodology — that should satisfy procurement.

I've attached the signed PO and our logo files for upload. See attachments: ACME_Docusign_aws_po.pdf (stub), acme-logo-primary.svg (stub), acme-logo-primary.png (stub).

Also sharing a DocuSign link for the seller agreement: https://www.docusign.com/link/abc123-acme-redwood (please countersign so we can finish seller registration).

If we get the DocuSign back by EOD Monday we'll target a private-offer creation on Tue.
